SECTION 2: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
================================================================================

Karan Bhardwaj is a Full-Stack Developer and Machine Learning Engineer who
specialises in building high-performance, commercially viable web ecosystems.

Unlike a standard developer who focuses solely on code execution, Karan builds
platforms that are simultaneously optimised for end-users, search engine
crawlers, and business growth — combining core software engineering with
Technical SEO, digital visibility strategy, and AI integration.

His core differentiator: he treats the entire product lifecycle — from database
schema design to SEO-structured markup to pixel-perfect 3D interfaces — as one
cohesive system.

He is available for:
- Full-time software engineering roles
- Freelance / contract projects
- Technical consulting (SEO + Full-Stack architecture)
- Open-source collaborations

SECTION 4: PROJECTS (DETAILED)
================================================================================

--- Project 1: Socioglamm ---
Type: Social Media + E-Commerce Platform
Status: Deployed (private company project)
Role: Lead Frontend Developer
Description:
  A complex dual-module platform integrating brand advertising E-commerce with
  community-driven social engagement (videos, reels, posts). Handled complex
  state management optimised for user retention, infinite scroll feeds,
  media upload pipelines, and brand discovery features.
Tech Stack: React.js, Redux, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS S3, Socket.io
Key Challenges: Real-time notifications, video streaming, large dataset pagination.

--- Project 2: Carsnbike ---
Type: Automotive Listing Platform
URL: https://www.carsnbike.com/
Status: Live and active
Role: Full-Stack Developer
Description:
  An automotive listing platform with location-based currency switching between
  USD (US users) and INR (Indian users). Features a dynamic CMS, vehicle search
  and filtering, and a blog system with SEO-structured content.
  Blog API endpoint: https://api.carsnbike.com/api/blog/
Tech Stack: Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, AWS EC2/S3, Nginx
Key Challenges: Location detection, currency conversion, large dataset CMS,
  sitemap generation for thousands of listing pages.

--- Project 3: FHM News ---
Type: News Aggregation Web Application
Status: Deployed
Role: Full-Stack Developer
Description:
  A news aggregation platform built with Next.js. Handles real-time API
  integration, dynamic news categories, infinite scroll pagination, and
  structured data for Google News inclusion. Implements Technical SEO with
  dynamic XML sitemaps per category and article schema markup.
Tech Stack: Next.js (App Router), Node.js, External news APIs, Vercel
Key Challenges: Dynamic sitemap generation per category, structured data
  implementation, pagination with infinite scroll, API rate limiting.

--- Project 4: Healthcare Mobile App ---
Type: Doctor Appointment Scheduling App
Status: Deployed to app stores
Role: Freelance Developer (first paid project)
Description:
  Cross-platform mobile application for doctor appointment scheduling.
  Implemented push notifications for appointment reminders and follow-ups.
  This was the first freelance project — real clients, real users, real stakes.
Tech Stack: React Native, Node.js, Firebase (push notifications), MongoDB

--- Project 5: Portfolio Website ---
Type: Personal Portfolio (this website)
URL: https://karanbhardwaj.in/
Status: Live
Description:
  A cinematic 3D portfolio built with React Three Fiber and Three.js. Features
  a scroll-driven 3D space scene with floating planet, star fields, sparkles,
  and smooth Lenis scroll animations. Includes pages for blogs, interests, and
  a 3D life-journey roadmap.
Tech Stack: React, Vite, Three.js, React Three Fiber, @react-three/drei,
  Framer Motion, GSAP, Lenis, React Router DOM

================================================================================
SECTION 5: LIFE JOURNEY / ROADMAP
================================================================================

2002 — Born in Patna, Bihar, India.
  Childhood marked by curiosity. Spent time exploring how things worked —
  radios, calculators, televisions. A mind wired for systems from day one.

2010 — First Teardown (Age ~8).
  Driven by curiosity about how voices come from a box, disassembled the
  family radio. The investigation was successful; the reassembly was not.
  Earned a legendary scolding but sparked a lifelong need to see what's
  under the hood of everything.

2014 — School Years (Age ~12).
  Competitive school environment. Science fairs, math olympiads. First
  exposure to Python on a borrowed laptop — love at first syntax.
  Problem-solving became an addiction.

2018 — The Foundation.
  Aced 10th board exams. Chose PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Maths) for Class
  11-12, driven entirely by a deep love of Physics. Parents proud.

2020 — The Pandemic Pivot.
  COVID-19 lockdown. While the world paused, the coding accelerated.
  12-hour sessions, online courses, building full-stack projects from scratch.
  React, Node.js, APIs, databases. First complete full-stack app built during
  lockdown. The world was ending; the code was shipping.

2021 — First Real Work.
  First freelance client: a healthcare mobile app for doctor appointment
  scheduling. Deployed to real users. First real feedback. First real money.
  The feeling of strangers using something you built is irreplaceable.

2023 — Going Deeper.
  Joined a startup. Built Socioglamm — a social media + E-commerce platform.
  Discovered that Technical SEO was a hidden superpower.
  Fell in love with Three.js and the idea that the web can be a cinematic
  experience, not just a flat document.

2024 — The Ecosystem.
  Built and deployed Carsnbike (automotive listing, location-based currency)
  and FHM News (Next.js news aggregation, dynamic sitemaps). Learned what
  it truly takes to build and maintain products at scale.

2025 — NOW.
  Graduated from Galgotias University with a B.Tech in Computer Science.
  Building systems at the intersection of beautiful code, business strategy,
  and search visibility. The road ahead is longer than what's behind.

================================================================================
SECTION 7: PHILOSOPHY & WORKING STYLE
================================================================================

Core belief:
  "I don't just want to write code — I want to build systems that outlast me."

Approach to development:
  - Business-first engineering: every technical decision is evaluated against
    its commercial and user impact, not just elegance.
  - SEO as architecture: search engine crawlability is designed in from the
    start, not bolted on as an afterthought.
  - Full ownership: manages the entire SDLC from requirements to deployment.
  - Aesthetics matter: believes that design and performance are not trade-offs.

Working style:
  - Deep focus sessions (typically 3-4 hour uninterrupted blocks)
  - Documentation-first for complex systems
  - Ships early, iterates fast
  - Prefers building in public and sharing learnings
